correctness.rationale: Use the cited Johnson intersection-matrix harmonic eigenvalue formula λ_j=(ζ-1)^j Σ_{l=0}^{k-j} C(k-j,l)^2 ζ^l with multiplicity C(2k,j)-C(2k,j-1); Legendre identity transforms the absolute values to (2sin(π/M))^k U_{k-j}(cot(π/M)). The displayed three-term recurrence has positive U_m for c>0, proving invertibility. For M≥4, c≥1 and positive recurrence make U_m nondecreasing, with M=4 tie at m=0,1; for M=3, T_m=3^{m/2}U_m(1/√3) obeys central-trinomial recurrence and r_m>√3 for m≥2, yielding minimum m=1 and maximum m=k with k=1,2 exceptions. Standard Laplace and generating-function singularity analysis gives the two sharp k-asymptotics at fixed M. Independent complex singular-value decomposition of the original balanced binary-slice matrices in all 15 cases k=1,2,3 and M=3,4,5,6,8 matches predicted full multiplicities to <6e-15. The finite SVD does not prove all k or reproduce the inaccessible original general eigenvalue theorem; reliance on the cited established intersection-scheme identity is explicit.
